column1: # Descriptions of definitions that have no docstring: path::qualname<TAB>text.
# Written from reading the code; a docstring, once written, takes precedence and
# scripts/build_code_map.py lists lines that no longer match a definition.

column2: Raises if the best mask shift (dy, dx) is larger than fluorescence.mask_max_shift_px in either direction.
The four quadrants of an image of the given shape, as (row slice, column slice) pairs.
Pearson correlation of two images over the pixels where the second is finite; NaN if too few pixels or either is constant.
The image minus its Gaussian-blurred background (sigma background_sigma_px), leaving cell-scale detail for matching.
Result of regressing a background trace out of each ROI: the cleaned traces (each row's mean kept) and one coefficient per ROI.

The ΔF/F0 versions of one plane: neuropil correction only, with the vessel background regressed out first, and also with each ROI's red trace regressed out (None when red is not usable), with the coefficients used.
Checks a regressor has the traces' frame count and finite values, and returns it minus its mean over frames.
Raises unless traces are a finite (n_rois, n_frames) array.
File name of the background-removed movie for one background source.
File name of the JSON record that goes with the background-removed movie of one source.
Mean green and red background fluorescence per frame for one source, with the background mask, its alignment onto this plane and the cache key they depend on.
SHA-256 of a boolean mask (bit-packed), so a cache knows when the mask changed.

The [batch] settings, validated: among them the raw and derivatives subject folders, the session range, the substring that picks source TIFFs, destriping, error handling, reruns, and the Cellpose masks and image for the post-batch extraction.
Reads and validates the [batch] table of a TOML file.
One row of the batch plan: session, source TIFF, run name and folder, the source's identity, and the action (run, skip or conflict) with its reason.
The latest batch_config_*.toml snapshot in the derivatives folder; raises if the batch was never launched.
A raw TIFF's resolved path, size and modification time, used to tell whether a run's source changed.
The (number, folder) of every ses-<n>_ folder in the session range; raises if any session in the range is missing.
The batch plan as a text table, one line per run, with a count of each action.
The current UTC time as an ISO string.
The command line that runs mini2p-preprocess on one planned run in a fresh Python process.
The pyControl time of each imaging frame and of each behavior-video frame, and the video file.
Loads the named arrays from a timing .npz; raises if the file or a key is missing, saying which script writes it.
Opens the video with ffmpeg as 8-bit gray frames, every decoded frame once, so frame k is row k of the camera's timing table.
Frame *index* of the video, reading forward only; raises for an earlier frame or one past the end.
Closes the ffmpeg reader.
Returns the reader, for use in a with block.
Closes the reader at the end of a with block.
One chunk's bidirectional phase estimate: the phase (px), its score, the margin over the next-best phase, whether it hit the search boundary, and the scores of every candidate.
The chosen phase in pixels.
The channel the phase was estimated on, counted from 0.
The peak score of each channel's estimate, by role.
The adjacent-line similarity of the mean frame after correcting it by phase_px.
Suite2p's own bidiphase estimate for a chunk, scored the same way as the wide search; flagged at the boundary when it reaches Suite2p's search limit.
Scores every phase from -max_shift_px to +max_shift_px on the chunk's mean frame and keeps the best, with its margin over the second best.
Which channel's estimate to use: the configured one, or under best_score the structural channel unless green scores higher by more than score_switch_margin.
Frames in each bin of about 0.5 s at this frame rate (at least 1).
A summary row for one run of the Cellpose batch, every field present (None until filled).
A summary row filled from a plane's extraction record: mask alignment fields, status and ROI count.
A warning when the masks were drawn on a registration of a different TIFF from this plane's, else None.
The plane's cellpose_extraction.json, or None if there is none.
Writes the batch's rows and a count per status to a JSON file and returns its path.
The batch summary as a text table: session, run, status, ROIs, mask shift, correlation after alignment, source check.
One review-PDF page for a run: the masks on the plane after alignment beside the masks as drawn, or whatever images exist.
Command-line options of mini2p-preprocess: config, raw TIFF, output folder and overrides.
mini2p-preprocess: loads the config, applies a --destripe override, and runs the pipeline on one raw TIFF.
mini2p-extract: extracts traces from Cellpose masks into a Suite2p plane folder, aligning the masks first when they were drawn on another registration's image.
Base for every settings model: immutable, and unknown keys are an error.
Validator: the structural and functional channel numbers must not exceed n_channels.
The one-based channel number of each role (functional, structural).
Display name of each channel number, e.g. "Channel 1 — red / structural".
Validator: the per-frame phase windows must be odd (centred on the frame), and manual per-chunk phases need the chunked method.
[destripe]: whether to remove stripes, and whether to keep each frame's mean brightness.
[distortion]: the mode (local_batched, cluster_full or off; required), the calibration .mat, depth, interpolation order, border crop and batch size.
Validator: drops the obsolete calibration_script_dir key, warning when a config sets it.
Validator: local_batched mode needs a transform_mat.

[registration]: among them frame rate, cell diameter, nonrigid, norm_frames, smooth_sigma, reference frames, bad-frame threshold, which channel motion is estimated on, the save_folder and an optional local fast_disk.
Validator: save_folder must name a folder inside the output folder, not "." or "..".
Validator: the focus window must be odd so it is centred on each frame.

The whole pipeline config: the channels, phase, destripe, distortion, registration, fluorescence and focus sections, plus top-level settings such as overwrite, max_timepoints (test runs) and the dtype of TIFFs written for Suite2p.
Validator: motion_alignment_source = "auto" needs the per-frame phase method, which it reads.
The numpy dtype of the TIFFs written for Suite2p.
The file-name suffix of the phase-corrected TIFF: dynamic_bidiphase, plus _destriped when destriping.
A copy of the settings with destriping turned on or off.
The plane0 folder of a registration: <variant>/aligned_<channel>/<save_folder>/plane0.
The run name (run-XX) of an output folder, whether it is the run folder or a variant inside it.
Path of the phase-corrected TIFF of a raw TIFF in an output folder.
Path of the distortion-corrected TIFF of a raw TIFF in an output folder.
Reads and validates the [qc] table that tells the QC notebook which run to look at.
An RGB image with the red display image in red and the green one in green.
What the bidiphase correction did: per-chunk records (chunked method), the global residual phase, per-frame phases (per-frame method) and how many values were clipped to the output dtype.
The global residual phase applied after the first correction, or None.
How many samples the global residual phase was estimated from, or None.
The JSON record of one chunk: its frames, first- and second-pass phases and the estimates behind them.
The part of the phase sidecar that says what was corrected: run, input and output TIFFs, channels.
The .distortion.json sidecar of a distortion-corrected TIFF: input, output, calibration, depth, interpolation, crop and shapes.
Display contrast of an exported mean image: black and white percentiles and gamma.
The contrast as text, e.g. "black 5%, white 99.5%, gamma 1.2".
[exports]: subject folder, session range, expected run count, the variant to export, and the default contrast.
The default contrast as a Contrast.
Reads and validates the [exports] table of a TOML file.
One run's plane folder, with its session and run numbers and names.
Raises unless exactly the expected number of runs was found.
The green and red mean images of a plane from its ops.npy; raises if missing or of different shapes.
Saves a file unless it exists and overwrite is off; returns "saved" or "existing".
The contrast choice saved for a plane by the QC notebook; raises if none was saved.
The runs that have both a chosen and a fixed contrast settings file.
Raises if the file exists and overwrite is off.
Traces extracted from masks: Suite2p stat, F and Fneu (and red F_chan2, Fneu_chan2), iscell and spks.
SHA-256 of a file's bytes, recorded so a later run knows which masks were used.
Raises if the masks' shape differs from the registered movie or ops' frame rate differs from the config.
Writes the extraction into the plane folder in Suite2p's file names, with cellpose_extraction.json recording the masks, settings and alignment.
Raises if an array has values that are not finite.
Robust standard deviation: 1.4826 × the median absolute deviation from the median.
Skewness of each ROI's ΔF/F0 (NaN for a constant trace).
Mean correlation between pairs of ROIs' traces, on at most PAIRWISE_MAX_ROIS evenly spaced ROIs.
F minus coefficient × Fneu, after checking the two match in shape and are finite.
ΔF/F0 of corrected traces: the baseline F0, ΔF = F − F0, and ΔF/F0 set to NaN wherever F0 is at or below min_f0.
Raises if any trace has NaN or inf (one bad frame would spread across a whole baseline window).
Raises if two trace arrays differ in shape.
Per-frame focus QC: each frame's correlation with the mean image, its running baseline, the drop below it in robust SDs, relative brightness, and the frames flagged.
For each window of a checked stage: where in the acquired signature it matches best, the correlations there and at its own position, and its status (in place, moved, ambiguous, unclear).
The frame-order check of one stage and channel: window matches, mismatched stretches, correlations with the acquired same and other channel, and frame counts.
How many windows have the given status.
True when the stage matches the acquired other channel better than its own.
True when the stage's file holds a different number of frames from the run.
True when no window moved or is unclear, nothing mismatched, channels are not swapped and the length is right.
One line saying whether the stage passed and how many windows are in place, moved, ambiguous or unclear.
Pearson correlation of two signatures over their common length.
True when per-frame phases were measured on the structural channel too.
Validator: expands ~ in a folder setting and refuses an empty one.
Validator: either run_dir, or all of cohort, subject, session, run and derivatives_root, must be set (run_dir wins, with a warning).
The processing stages chosen for movies, in pipeline order.
The movie versions chosen: unaveraged, averaged or both.
The single folder found; raises listing what is there when none or several match.
The plane0 of a variant's registration (alignment channel, save_folder); raises saying whether Suite2p has not finished or never ran.
The channels a movie shows: green and red for side_by_side, else the one chosen.
Frames start to stop of a movie source, as float32 (the interface every source implements).
Memory-maps a Suite2p int16 binary; raises if its size does not match the frame count and shape.
Frames start to stop of the binary, as float32.
A source reading one channel of an interleaved TIFF.
Frames start to stop of the TIFF's channel, as float32; raises if the TIFF is shorter.
A source showing only the given rows and columns of another.
Frames start to stop of the underlying source, cropped.
The averaged, spatially smoothed movie frames of each window, read in one go.
How many frames an encoded movie file holds, by ffmpeg's count.
One movie to write: its plan, frame sources per channel, frame span, title, frame rate and optional behavior video.
Renders and encodes one movie job to an MP4 in the output folder, logging when whole averaging windows shorten the requested span.
NATEX results for one ROI: baseline, ΔF/F0, low-passed ΔF/F0 and which frames are in significant transients.
NATEX results for every ROI of a plane: baselines, ΔF/F0, significant frames, cleaned events, SNR, fraction of undefined frames and event counts.
SHA-256 of a file's bytes.
Detector readings as a flat float array; raises if empty or not finite.
Refines the photon-free level and its spread a few times from the readings near it.
Fraction of readings far below the level (more than FAR_BELOW_SDS spreads).
Raises when too few readings sit near the level, or too many far below it, for it to be a photon-free level.
Photon-free level per frame of each channel, the raw-frame pixels each was measured on, and the cache key.
What a run's photon-free levels depend on (TIFF identity, frame count, channels, settings), as the cache key.
Measures the photon-free level of every frame of each channel from the raw TIFF; raises if its timepoints do not match the registered frames.
Raises unless the levels cover exactly the traces' frames.
What one pipeline run produced: the corrected TIFF, the TIFF given to Suite2p, the plane folder and the correction summary.
Logs how long a pipeline stage took and returns the time now, for timing the next stage.

One raw TIFF end to end: bidiphase correction (and destriping) with its frame-phase plot, the settings record, distortion correction (local_batched; cluster_full expects it done), and Suite2p registration, logging how long each stage took.
A plane's extracted traces and what goes with them: F, Fneu, red F_chan2 and Fneu_chan2, iscell, stat, ops and a label image of the ROIs.
The plane's frame rate from ops.
Loads a .npy file if it exists, else None.
Loads a plane folder's traces, ROIs and ops; raises if nothing has been extracted yet.
The given axes reshaped to rows × columns, or a new figure's axes when none are given.
The wide bidiphase search's score at every candidate phase, with the chosen phase marked.
Raises when the image columns of a comparison figure do not line up with their titles, channels, display-range columns or zoom box.
The median nonrigid block offsets (x and y) over the recording, in minutes.
One Okabe–Ito color per method; raises if there are more methods than colors.
A duration as short text: "1h05m", "3m20s" or "45s".
A progress reporter for *total* items that reports through *report*, at most every min_interval_s (clocks injectable for tests).
Every channel of timepoints start to end of a TIFF; raises if start is outside the recording, and an end past it is clipped to the last timepoint.
Per-frame line-similarity curves of a stretch of frames and the phases chosen from them, for previewing the per-frame bidiphase step.
The chunk whose phase estimate scored lowest (the least certain one); raises if no score is finite.
The mean image of each stack.
A registration offset array from ops, checked for its dimensions, frame count and finite values.
A raw TIFF to preview: its session, path and start time, and where the time came from (ScanImage epoch or file modification time).
A copy of the settings with the motion alignment channel set.
The channel motion is estimated on; raises if "auto" has not been resolved yet.

Suite2p's db for one registration: the input TIFF alone (an explicit file list), the save path and save_folder, and the fast_disk: the configured one, or for a save_folder other than suite2p a folder inside it, so its binaries are its own.
Which channel motion was estimated on and why; for "auto", the fraction of frames whose phase trusted the structural channel and the threshold.
The Suite2p input TIFF's path, size and modification time, recorded with a registration.
A binary's path, size and modification time, recorded so the binary can later be shown to be this registration's.
The motion_alignment.json record: the channel, why, the auto fraction and threshold, and the input identity.
A registration's ops and its registered green (data.bin) and red (data_chan2.bin) movies, memory-mapped.
Loads a plane's ops and memory-maps its registered binaries, checking each binary belongs to this registration.
Loads a plane folder's ops.npy.
Writes the comparison rows to a CSV, one column per measure.
The file stems of the comparison table and image figure, in <aligned folder>/registration_comparison/.
The values the figure captions are filled with: recording, crop, frames, blocks, patch size, cell settings.
Numbers sorted with None last, for error messages.
How many values a TIFF of these timepoints, channels and frame shape holds.
